verdict.rationale: dlt is itself an official open-source Python library, installable via pip, with a documented programmatic API: `dlt.pipeline(...)`, `pipeline.run`, `pipeline.dataset()` with Ibis/SQL/dataframe queries, and a decorator-based Python API for deployment. Community users praise its code quality, documentation and ease of integration, and value being able to do everything in code. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond Python (no other language bindings evidenced), in-depth API reference or versioning documentation in the pack.
